svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="T_Txx3Xaxb4ICrfqFrLV"> <mxGraphModel dx="857" dy="-603" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam actorStyle awesome
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam usecase {
 BackgroundColor #F0F4FF
 BorderColor #3A6BD4
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontSize 11
}
skinparam actor {
 BackgroundColor #E8F0FE
 BorderColor #1D4ED8
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontSize 11
 FontStyle bold
}
skinparam package {
 BackgroundColor #FAFCFF
 BorderColor #93B4E8
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontStyle bold
}
skinparam arrow {
 Color #3A6BD4
 FontColor #3A6BD4
 FontSize 10
}

left to right direction

' ── Actors ───────────────────────────────────────
actor \"Admin\" as Admin #LightSteelBlue
actor \"Teacher\" as Teacher #PaleGreen
actor \"Student\" as Student #LightSalmon
actor \"AI Engine\n(Gemini+Dlib+FAISS)\" as AI #Plum
actor \"Gate Scanner\" as Gate #LightGray

' ── System Boundary ──────────────────────────────
rectangle \"AI-Driven Smart LMS\" {

 package \"Authentication\" {
 usecase \"Login (Email /\nFace Recognition)\" as UC_Login
 }

 package \"Academic Management\" {
 usecase \"Manage Departments,\nPrograms & Courses\" as UC_Academic
 usecase \"Manage Semesters\n& Offerings\" as UC_Offer
 usecase \"Manage Enrollments\" as UC_Enroll
 }

 package \"Attendance System\" {
 usecase \"Mark Lecture\nAttendance (Level 1)\" as UC_LecAtt
 usecase \"Campus Gate\nFace Scan (Level 2)\" as UC_GateScan
 usecase \"View Attendance\nReports & Alerts\" as UC_AttRpt
 }

 package \"Assessment\" {
 usecase \"Create & Submit\nAssignments\" as UC_Assign
 usecase \"Create & Take\nQuizzes\" as UC_Quiz
 usecase \"Create Exams &\nEnter Results\" as UC_Exam
 }

 package \"AI-Powered Features\" {
 usecase \"Face Recognition\nLogin & Attendance\" as UC_Face
 usecase \"AI Chatbot\n(Gemini + RAG)\" as UC_Chatbot
 usecase \"Generate AI Quiz\n(Gemini)\" as UC_AIQuiz
 usecase \"Plagiarism\nDetection\" as UC_Plag
 usecase \"Student Analytics\n& Leaderboard\" as UC_Analytics
 }

 package \"Fee Management\" {
 usecase \"Generate Vouchers\n& Record Payments\" as UC_Fee
 }

 package \"Communication\" {
 usecase \"Announcements,\nNotices & Chat\" as UC_Comm
 }
}

' ── Admin Associations ───────────────────────────
Admin --> UC_Login
Admin --> UC_Academic
Admin --> UC_Offer
Admin --> UC_Enroll
Admin --> UC_AttRpt
Admin --> UC_Fee
Admin --> UC_Comm
Admin --> UC_Analytics
Admin --> UC_Face

' ── Teacher Associations ─────────────────────────
Teacher --> UC_Login
Teacher --> UC_LecAtt
Teacher --> UC_AttRpt
Teacher --> UC_Assign
Teacher --> UC_Quiz
Teacher --> UC_AIQuiz
Teacher --> UC_Exam
Teacher --> UC_Plag
Teacher --> UC_Analytics
Teacher --> UC_Comm

' ── Student Associations ─────────────────────────
Student --> UC_Login
Student --> UC_Enroll
Student --> UC_Assign
Student --> UC_Quiz
Student --> UC_Chatbot
Student --> UC_Analytics
Student --> UC_Fee
Student --> UC_Comm
Student --> UC_AttRpt

' ── AI Engine Associations ───────────────────────
AI --> UC_Face
AI --> UC_Chatbot
AI --> UC_AIQuiz
AI --> UC_Plag
AI --> UC_Analytics

' ── Gate Scanner Associations ────────────────────
Gate --> UC_GateScan

' ── Include / Extend ─────────────────────────────
UC_Login .> UC_Face : <<extend>>
UC_LecAtt .> UC_AttRpt : <<include>>
UC_GateScan .> UC_AttRpt : <<include>>
UC_AIQuiz .> UC_Quiz : <<extend>>
UC_Plag .> UC_Assign : <<extend>>

@enduml
",
 "format": "svg"
}" id="14pVjtuajESJFR7WagT--21"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1581" width="437" x="20" y="1100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
